Game Overview

At its heart, Army Commander is a strategy game about become a master strategist in Army Commander, where the battlefield is your canvas. Gather and upgrade a formidable force of tanks, bazookas, and planes. Anticipate reinforcement drops and tactically overpower foes. Command wisely to shift the balance of war in your favor and lead your army to victory.
